column2: [intro]
When I enter the room, people rise,
My energy’s short, but it’s a surprise.
I leap around, I spin and twirl,
I’m the clown who makes the party whirl.
I’m here, in a tonic state,
Life’s a melody I celebrate.
They call me the king of groove,
I make even rooftop pigeons move.
I’ve got songs that make you laugh out loud,
Choruses that stir up the crowd.
My voice loops and soars through the air,
I’m the fireworks that make heads turn and stare.
I’m here, in a tonic state,
The stage is my magic gate.
People groove, smiles appear,
In my world where the groove is clear.
[ solo ]
I’m here, in a tonic state,
Life’s a melody I celebrate.
They call me the king of groove,
I make even rooftop pigeons move.
[outro]
